title: ilex crenata subsp. radicans
intro: Ilex crenata subsp. radicans, commonly known as Japanese Holly, is a plant species native to East Asia, characterized by its holly-like leaves and small red berries. The health benefits of Ilex crenata subsp. radicans include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Ilex crenata subsp. radicans include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
